name: Fruit Million Respin

features.name: Expanding wild respins
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 expand and trigger respins.

review:
The same bright green look and 100 lines as Fruit Million, with one big change: when a wild lands on reel 2, 3 or 4, it expands over the reel, pays, and gives you a respin.

Those respins can stack random multipliers across the reels, which gives this version more punch than the original. No complicated bonus – just fast classic play with expanding-wild respins. Medium volatility, 3,000x max and a 97% RTP. A good upgrade if Fruit Million felt a bit flat.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
